The default multiplier is 1.
Each physical skill gains 5 base XP per accumulated game minute of movement while wearing the belt: 50 for 10 minutes and 300 for 1 game hour.
Base XP = qualifying game minutes of movement × 5 × this multiplier.
Final XP also includes native XP settings, character traits and applicable protein-drink bonuses.
